meta.title: Video Subtitle Downloader
meta.description: Fetch a Bilibili video's subtitles into a local subtitle file. Restart the desktop app once and a “Video Subtitle” page shows up in Settings; scan a QR code with the Bilibili app on that page and you are logged in; the official subtitle API then signs the request with that login and usually answers in under a second. If the local transcription setup is missing pieces, one button on the page installs everything and shows the progress step by step; otherwise it falls back to local faster-whisper transcription and local speech recognition. Can fetch many videos or every 分P of a collection in one call, and can merge fragment subtitles into readable sentences plus a plain transcript. Returns only metadata (title, duration, character counts, file paths) — the transcript itself is read on demand by time range.
